list.title: AI employees
list.description: Each employee has a role, memory, scoped tools and an explicit autonomy level.
list.emptyDescription: Pick a role template from the marketplace below to hire your first AI employee.

detail.pausedBudget: Paused because a budget cap was reached. Raise the daily budget under “Tools & autonomy” (or the workspace monthly budget), then Resume.

outputLanguage.label: Output language
outputLanguage.help: The language this employee writes answers, documents and emails in.

instructions.confirmSaveWithoutReplay: Save without comparing against past tasks?
instructions.replayStarted: Replay started on past tasks (dry run, no side effects)

replay.summary: Old vs new output on {count, plural, one {# past task} other {# past tasks}} · {credits} credits · {when}

allowList.title: Owner allow-list
allowList.description: Only applies at {level} autonomy. Matching irreversible actions run without per-action approval; anything outside the scope still stops at an approval.
allowList.clientContactsOnlyHelp: Allows the email's client's main address and any contact saved for that client.
allowList.recipientRule: Every recipient must match at least one of these rules (a domain, an exact address, or the client's file); otherwise the email stops at an approval.
allowList.noRecipientRule: No recipient rule: any recipient is allowed within this scope.

memory.placeholder: Teach a fact, e.g. 'Kopi Nusantara prefers English'
memory.empty: No memories yet. Rejection feedback from the Approvals inbox lands here automatically.
memory.untrustedHelp: Saved by a run that read outside content: recalled as data only, never as instructions.

history.title: History
history.undoneExpiryCleared: Change undone. Its expiry date had passed, so it no longer expires.

memory.clientHelp: Learned on work for this client: recalled only on that client's work.

toolPermissions.mcpServerDescription: All tools of this connected MCP server (classified by verb; unknown = irreversible)
toolPermissions.disabledWins: A disabled tool rule always wins: switch a tool off here and no broader grant can turn it back on. The server switch above is the master grant.
toolPermissions.serverNotGranted: Grant the server first; per-tool rules only narrow what the server grant allows.
toolPermissions.selectorInvalid: Use only letters, digits, _ . - and * (at most 8 *, and not just *).
toolPermissions.selectorHelp: A tool name or a pattern with * (list_* matches list_contacts); saved in lower case with other characters as _ (Contacts.Delete → contacts_delete). New rules block their tools; switch one on to allow it instead.
toolPermissions.implicitTask: Granted automatically in tasks; switch it off to stop this employee from reporting progress.

kb_search.label: Knowledge base search
kb_search.description: Search the workspace knowledge base with citations

memory_save.label: Save memory
memory_save.description: Store a fact in the employee's long-term memory

list_clients.label: List clients
list_clients.description: List clients and projects from master data

get_client.label: Get client
get_client.description: Read one client with contacts and projects

list_tasks.label: List tasks
list_tasks.description: Read recent tasks and deliverables in the workspace

web_fetch.label: Fetch web page
web_fetch.description: Read a public web page (text only)

draft_document.label: Draft document
draft_document.description: Create a document or code deliverable (with diff vs previous version)

draft_email.label: Draft email
draft_email.description: Write an email draft without sending it

draft_invoice.label: Draft invoice
draft_invoice.description: Generate an invoice PDF draft for a client

create_task.label: Create task
create_task.description: Create a task on the board (from chat)

delegate_subtask.label: Delegate subtask
delegate_subtask.description: Team lead: assign a subtask to a team member

request_revision.label: Request revision
request_revision.description: Team lead: send a subtask back with feedback

message_teammate.label: Message teammate
message_teammate.description: Send a structured message to another employee

ask_teammate.label: Ask a colleague
ask_teammate.description: Chat: bring a colleague into this chat to help; they reply right after (granted automatically in chats)

send_email.label: Send email
send_email.description: Send an email via workspace SMTP

send_invoice.label: Send invoice
send_invoice.description: Email an invoice PDF to a client

post_webhook.label: Publish to webhook
post_webhook.description: Publish a message to a configured webhook (Slack/Telegram/WhatsApp gateway)

skill_read.label: Read skill
skill_read.description: Read one of its assigned skills (SKILL.md) by name. Granted automatically while at least one switched-on skill is assigned.

skill_propose.label: Propose skill
skill_propose.description: Propose a new reusable skill (SKILL.md) from what it learned. A person approves it before it is saved and assigned.

list_invoices.label: List invoices
list_invoices.description: Read the invoice ledger (numbers, totals, status, due dates) and the company's invoice prefix

report_progress.label: Report progress
report_progress.description: Report how much of the current task is done (0–100%) with a short note

git_push.label: Push branch
git_push.description: Workspace mode: push the committed work to agent/<task> on the remote (the platform pushes after approval)

create_pull_request.label: Open pull request
create_pull_request.description: Workspace mode: open a pull/merge request from the branch (after approval)

list_apps.label: List apps
list_apps.description: Workspace mode: the workspace's apps (preview address, status, repository, branch, the version that runs) so the employee knows which app to preview

request_preview.label: Publish preview
request_preview.description: Workspace mode: publish the pushed branch as a preview of an app at its address (the platform deploys after approval)

request_release.label: Propose LIVE release
request_release.description: Workspace mode: propose releasing a preview version that already ran to the app's live site (only the Owner can approve it)

handoff_to_division.label: Hand off to division
handoff_to_division.description: Division head: hand work over to another division as a new task (deliverables go along as data)

executionMode.label: Execution mode
executionMode.workspace: Workspace mode (Claude Code in a sandbox)
executionMode.toolHelp: Uses only platform tools such as drafts, email and the knowledge base. Recommended for Finance, Sales and Support.
executionMode.workspaceHelp: Runs Claude Code (shell, files, git) in an isolated per-task sandbox. Risky commands still need approval.
executionMode.egressHelp: One host per line, e.g. registry.npmjs.org or *.pypi.org. Everything else is blocked. Adding hosts needs a 2FA confirmation.

receipt.request_revision: Sent a subtask back for revision
receipt.stopped_stalled: Stopped: the run made no progress
receipt.stopped_loop: Stopped: the run was going in circles
receipt.waiting_for_preview: Waiting for the platform to deploy the approved preview
receipt.waiting_for_live: Waiting for the platform to release the approved version to LIVE
receipt.live_deployed: LIVE now runs the new version at {url}
receipt.subagent_started: Started its part as a subagent: {task}
receipt.subagent_finished: Finished its part as a subagent
receipt.subagent_failed: Its part as a subagent ended with an error
receipt.dependencies_done: The subtasks it waited for are done: starting
receipt.subtask_blocked: Blocked: a subtask it waits for did not finish
receipt.division_budget_cap: Paused: the division's daily budget is used up
receipt.waiting_for_prd_decision: Waiting for the owner to decide on the PRD
receipt.team_review_failed: Did not accept the work: the task failed
receipt.team_review_no_verdict: The review ended without a verdict

bot.label: Bot avatar
bot.help: How this employee looks in chat, lists and approvals. Whatever stays automatic is picked so it doesn't clash with another employee.
bot.adminOnly: Only an Owner or Admin can change the avatar.
bot.colorHelp: This is also the employee's sign colour on the dashboard and in the office.

specialty.label: Specialty
specialty.placeholder: e.g. React and Tailwind interfaces, accessible forms
specialty.help: One line. The division head and the code lead read it when they decide who does what.
